content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I recently encountered an issue with [product_name] monitor mode. I uploaded my program and was able to enter monitor mode, but I couldn't see any input or output states, nor was there any error code. Has anyone come across a similar problem? Thank you for your responses!
I'm not sure I understand your issue. Could you clarify further or provide a screenshot?

Unfortunately, I don't have a screenshot. Monitor mode was active and I observed sensor signal changes reflected on the [product_name] input indication, but these changes didn't appear in the program.
Can you specify what you mean by monitor mode? Are you referring to Online Test? Also, the [product_name] doesn't actually have input LEDs.
Yes, I was referring to Online Test. That was my mistake—the [product_name] doesn't have input LEDs; I actually checked the I/O display.
Could you upload your program in a zip file and indicate which input you are referring to?

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced an issue with the monitoring feature of [product_name], where changes in physical sensor inputs did not show as expected in the program while using monitor mode (Online Test). No errors appeared, but the program's display failed to reflect real input/output states. This situation led to communication challenges and made troubleshooting the automation logic difficult.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that activating monitor mode should accurately display real-time input and output states in the software, corresponding to actual sensor signals, and without error messages.
